name: Investor TM + screening
description: Behavioural rules on investor flows; PEP / sanctions / adverse-media screening at registration + on changes.

name: Project-owner DD + use-of-funds monitor
description: UBO unwinding; PEP / sanctions screening; periodic use-of-funds attestation from project owner.

name: Secondary-market surveillance
